nodes.label: Headcount scaling of the line
nodes.expr: IF(line.drv == 'us', hc.us / hc.us_seed, IF(line.drv == 'gcc', hc.gcc / hc.gcc_seed, IF(line.drv == 'ctr', hc.ctr / hc.ctr_seed, 1)))

nodes.label: CY26 cash capex by pool
nodes.expr: SUM(l in line where l.pool == pool, base.line_capex[l])

nodes.label: Addressable spend by pool
nodes.expr: SUM(l in line where l.pool == pool, base.line_addressable[l])

nodes.label: CY27 status-quo growth by pool
nodes.expr: SUM(l in line where l.pool == pool, base.line_growth[l])
SUM(l in line where l.addr == 'locked', base.line_outlay[l])

nodes.label: Airline platform spend not locked
nodes.expr: SUM(l in line where AND(l.pool == 'airline_platforms', l.addr != 'locked'), base.line_outlay[l])
lev.on['L05'] * lv.us_total * lev.L05.sl * lev.L05.sev + lev.L05.r * lv.us_cost * lev.L05.reloc_sev + (lev.L05.h * lev.L05.bf + lev.L05.r) * lev.L05.hire_cost
lev.on['L07'] * lev.L07.ext * SAFEDIV(lv.tail, lv.ext, 0) * lev.L07.pct * lev.L07.diff
lev.on['L10'] * (lev.L09.sw9 * lev.L10.shelf + lev.L10.msp * (1 - lev.L10.shelf) * lev.L10.ms + (lev.L09.sw9 - lev.L10.msp) * (1 - lev.L10.shelf) * lev.L10.ren * lev.L10.rcut)
lev.on['L12'] * (lv.dc_maint * lev.L12.tpm * lev.L12.tpm_saving + lv.dc_colo * lev.L12.colo) + lev.L12.capex_saving

nodes.label: Remaining third-party spend
nodes.expr: lev.L08.ext - lev.L08.rr + lv.cons * (1 - lev.on['L02'] * lev.L02.cut) + lev.L09.sw9 - lev.L10.rr + lev.L09.cl9 - lev.L11.rr + lv.dc_maint + lv.dc_colo + lv.net + lv.euc + lv.fees

nodes.label: One-time cost to achieve (before funding split)
Share of run-rate realised in CY27 (linear ramp)
nodes.expr: IF(13 - lev.eff_start <= lev.ramp, (13 - lev.eff_start) * (14 - lev.eff_start) / (2 * lev.ramp), (lev.ramp + 1) / 2 + (13 - lev.eff_start - lev.ramp)) / 12

cases.expr: IF(pool == 'si_contingent', lev.L03.h * lv.on_cost, 0) - IF(pool == 'captive_labour', lev.L03.h * lv.gcc_cost * wf.prod_factor, 0)
IF(pool == 'si_contingent', lev.L04.h * lv.off_cost, 0) - IF(pool == 'captive_labour', lev.L04.h * lv.gcc_cost * lev.L04.pf, 0)
lev.L09.rr * (IF(pool == 'software', lev.L09.split_sw, 0) + IF(pool == 'cloud', lev.L09.split_cloud, 0) + IF(pool == 'dc_hardware', 1 - lev.L09.split_sw - lev.L09.split_cloud, 0))

lev.on['L16'] * lev.L16.pct * (IF(pool == 'si_contingent', lev.L08.ext - lev.L08.rr, 0) + IF(pool == 'consulting', lv.cons * (1 - lev.on['L02'] * lev.L02.cut), 0) + IF(pool == 'software', lev.L09.sw9 - lev.L10.rr, 0) + IF(pool == 'cloud', lev.L09.cl9 - lev.L11.rr, 0) + IF(pool == 'dc_hardware', lv.dc_maint + lv.dc_colo, 0) + IF(pool == 'network', lv.net, 0) + IF(pool == 'end_user', lv.euc, 0) + IF(pool == 'airline_platforms', lv.fees, 0))
IF(pool == 'si_contingent', lev.L17.si_avoid, 0) + IF(pool == 'software', lev.L17.sw_avoid, 0) + IF(pool == 'cloud', lev.L17.cl_avoid, 0)

nodes.label: Check: pool effects sum to run-rate (must be 0)
nodes.expr: lev.rr - SUM(p in pool, lev.eff[lever, p])

cases.expr: SUM(p in pool, lev.eff[lever, p] * base.pool_capex_share[p])

nodes.expr: SUM(p in pool, lev.eff[lever, p] * pool.swb_flag[p] * (1 - base.pool_capex_share[p]))

nodes.expr: hc.gcc + lev.L03.gcc_add + lev.L04.h * lev.L04.pf + (lev.L05.h * lev.L05.bf + lev.L05.r) * wf.prod_factor

nodes.expr: SAFEDIV(res.fte_gcc + res.fte_off, res.fte_gcc + res.fte_off + res.fte_us + res.fte_on, 0)

Outlay owned by VP
nodes.expr: SUM(l in line where l.pool == pool, base.line_outlay[l] * org.dom_share[l.domain, vp])

nodes.label: Share of pool owned by VP

nodes.expr: SUM(l in line, base.line_addressable[l] * org.dom_share[l.domain, vp])

nodes.label: Shared-services VP slice of pool
nodes.expr: SUM(u in vp, vp.alloc[u, pool] * org.ss_flag[u])

nodes.label: Non-shared spend owned (usage proxy)
nodes.expr: SUM(p in pool, vp.alloc[vp, p] * base.pool_outlay[p] * (1 - pool.shared[p]))

nodes.label: Effective allocation after chargeback
nodes.expr: vp.alloc + g.chargeback_on * pool.shared[pool] * (vp.ss_alloc[pool] * vp.usage - org.ss_flag[vp] * vp.ss_alloc[pool])

nodes.label: Shared-services addressable spend in shared pools
nodes.expr: SUM(u in vp, org.ss_flag[u] * SAFEDIV(vp.addressable[u] * SUM(p in pool, vp.alloc[u, p] * base.pool_outlay[p] * pool.shared[p]), SUM(p in pool, vp.alloc[u, p] * base.pool_outlay[p]), 0))

nodes.label: VP's own CY27 cost growth
nodes.expr: SUM(p in pool, base.pool_growth[p] * vp.eff_alloc[vp, p])

nodes.label: VP net target
nodes.expr: IF(g.vp_target_method == 1, SAFEDIV((res.target + SUM(u in vp, vp.growth[u])) * vp.eff_addr, SUM(u in vp, vp.eff_addr[u]), 0) - vp.growth, IF(g.vp_target_method == 2, IF(vp.eff_addr > 0, SAFEDIV(res.target, vp.n_active, 0), 0), org.manual_target))

cases.expr: SAFEDIV(SUM(p in pool where p.third_party == 1, vp.eff_alloc[vp, p] * base.pool_outlay[p]), SUM(p in pool where p.third_party == 1, base.pool_outlay[p]), 0)

nodes.label: VP share of lever
nodes.expr: IF(g.vp_alloc_method == 1, vp.key_share[vp, lever.alloc_key], SAFEDIV(SUM(p in pool, lev.eff[lever, p] * vp.eff_alloc[vp, p]), lev.rr[lever], 0))
SUM(l in lever, lev.iy[l] * vp.lever_share[l, vp])
SUM(l in lever, lev.iy_risk[l] * vp.lever_share[l, vp])

nodes.label: One-time charged to IT
nodes.expr: SUM(l in lever, lev.ot[l] * vp.lever_share[l, vp]) * g.ot_in_year * (1 - g.ot_out_share)
